title: Boston Skydive Center
specs: Located within an hour from Boston and Worcester, and less than 20 minutes from Providence
Scenic views of Narragansett Bay and Providence River
Must be at least 18 years old with photo ID
Cannot weigh more than 240 lbs and must be height-to-weight proportionate and in generally good health
Complete all electronic waivers and training ahead of time
Group booking with $50 deposit per person; group discounts applied upon arrival

services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Skydiving is the closest thing we humans get to flight - and, yes, it’s as life-affirming and joyous as we dream it to be! When you watch yourself on video, overcoming your fear and crushing your goal like a boss, you’ll feel a powerful surge of empowerment all over again. Your instructor will wear an HD wrist-mounted camera with a wide-angle lens to capture your full skydiving experience. At Boston Skydive Center, we use Shred - lightning-fast editing software that was designed especially for extreme sports. Digitally receive three edits of your tandem skydive by the end of the day (as long as the Internet Gods cooperate!). Insta Movie 50 Seconds Your ultimate skydiving highlight reel -

gap: Exact duration of the tandem skydive experience not stated
blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving where they jump attached to an experienced instructor. The jump includes a safety briefing, scenic flight, freefall at 120 mph, parachute glide, and post-jump celebration. The center operates May through October, weather dependent.
extraNote: Change reservation without penalty up to 48 hours before jump date · $50 fee to change reservation within 48 hours of jump date · Boston Skydive Center, North Central State Airport, 300 Jenckes Hill Rd, Smithfield, RI 02917. Use 'Boston Skydive Center' in GPS, not airport name or address. · May through October
